text:
mira: quick q — can we add a focused perf + compatibility gate for quantized runtimes and kv-cache interaction? saw a couple of weird tail spikes on 4-bit flows this week.

devon: +1. We need a microbench harness that replays a small canonical corpus and measures cold vs warm paths, p50/p95/p99/p99.9, mem, and kv-hit-rate. lightweight, runnable in CI and as a local dev tool.

sophia: agree. Prefer reusing perf-prober if possible, add a 'kv-warmup' phase that primes the prefix cache. Also we should capture model binary size and mmap pressure. thresholds we can iterate on, but we should codify them. :clipboard:

alex_k: prefer a staged rollout: soft-fail for public hosted intake (create a blocker ticket & require reviewer signoff for first 10k tokens); hard-fail for Dedicated/Private by default. avoids blocking experimentation.

mira: sketch of harness API/CLI:
```
bench-run --model $MODEL_ID --seq 256 --iters 1000 --warmup 200 --measure latency,p99,p999,mem,kv_rate --golden-ref ref:model:v1
```
outputs a small json summary + histogram artifacts.

devon: +recommendations:
- golden-inputs: sample ~100 prompts across prompt-classes (instruction, few-shot, long-context)
- baseline against pinned ref model and a quantized baseline (same arch)
- metrics: latency_ratio (model/ref), output-drift-flag (fuzzy match), kv_hit_pct

sophia: compatibility lint checklist (pre-ingest):
- tokenizer vocab hash matches or compatible mapping
- special token ids stable
- signature/abi: supports streaming+kv cache flags
If any fail -> reject. If only perf fails -> soft-fail with auto-created ticket.

onboard-bot: created gate perf-smoke-quantized (owner: @devon) — severity: warn, run: perf-smoke-harness, docs: /playbooks/onboard-perf

alex_k: operational notes: add prober to canary pipeline and alert on p99 delta > 2x or p99.9 > 500ms absolute for seq256 on hosted tier. Add a rolling window so noisy one-offs don't block admission.

mira: devon - can you add harness + CI job? sophia - can you author the lint rules? i'll assemble the golden prompt set. aim for an RFC follow-up Thurs 11am PT to sign off.

devon: yea i'll spike this week. plan: implement prober adapter, output json schema, and a lightweight sarif-like report for infra.

sophia: i'll draft the lint PR and include example failure messages so SRE/product know next steps.

mira: thanks all. small follow-ups: add runbook snippet for how to triage kv-warmup regressions, and a quick playbook for owners to override soft-fails when justified.

onboard-bot: reminder: create issue templates for perf regressions -> linking to runbook.
